reels.hook: Kya ply sach mein waterproof hoti hai? Barish aur paani se ply phool kar tootne lagti hai, jabki VAJRA PP shuttering she
Bhari ply chhodho aur switch kijiye lightweight PP shuttering sheet par jo paani se bilkul nahi phoolti.
Dhalai ke baad sirf paani se dhoiye aur agle slab ke liye use kijiye!

images.hook: Slab, beam, column: sab VAJRA PP shuttering sheet se. Swipe karke dekho 👉

Site pe lagao, kaam shuru. Column aur slab dono.
